task:
A fund holds 6183 credits. Its first grant is 17% of that original balance. Return 44% of this grant to the fund, so that portion is not spent. A second grant is 7% of the original balance minus 7 credits (the 7 credits are subtracted BEFORE taking the percentage). What is total spending after the returned portion? Give an exact answer. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 11 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 18% surcharge, then subtract 3 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 19 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 11% surcharge, then subtract 9 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 25 credits, then discount the whole amount by 11%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 5% surcharge, then subtract 14 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 26 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 16% surcharge, then subtract 3 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 4 credits, then discount the whole amount by 4%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 18% surcharge, then subtract 21 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 8 credits, then discount the whole amount by 15%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 13% surcharge, then subtract 19 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 3 credits, then discount the whole amount by 6%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 4% surcharge, then subtract 24 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 8 credits, then discount the whole amount by 4%.
Adjustment 16: apply a 9% surcharge, then subtract 17 credits.
Adjustment 17: add 19 credits, then discount the whole amount by 19%.
Adjustment 18: apply a 4% surcharge, then subtract 20 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 6 credits, then discount the whole amount by 4%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
